title: Schedule of Dental Discounts — Cascade Smile Savings Memberships
content:
# Schedule of Dental Discounts

This schedule sets the dental discount percentages of the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships. Each percentage is a whole-number percent off the usual fee for the service category. Discounts are honored only at practices holding a savings-network agreement, and they apply to the practice's usual fee as filed for its ZIP region (the regional discount schedule).

## Discount percentages by membership

| Membership | Preventive | Basic restorative | Major (crowns, bridges, dentures) | Orthodontic treatment | Specialist services | Implant services | Cosmetic (such as whitening) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | 40% | 30% | 20% | 15% | 15% | 15% | 25% |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | 40% | 30% | 20% | 15% | 15% | 15% | 25% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | 45% | 30% | 20% | 15% | 20% | 15% | 25% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | 45% | 30% | 20% | 15% | 20% | 15% | 25% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | 50% | 35% | 25% | 20% | 25% | 20% | 30% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | 50% | 35% | 25% | 20% | 25% | 20% | 30% |

The preventive percentage applies to preventive services at savings-network practices.

## Where the discount is honored

| Membership | Savings-network agreement required | Discount at practices outside the savings network | Fee basis | Days after a visit to report a practice that did not honor the discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| All six memberships listed above | Yes | 0% (no discount) | Practice's usual fee as filed for its ZIP region | 90 calendar days |

A discount outside the savings network of 0 percent means no discount. The visit-price dispute period is the number of calendar days after a visit within which the member may report a practice that did not honor the discount.

## Points of judgement

- **Same category, different memberships.** A preventive service carries 40 percent off on the two Cascade Smile Savings memberships, 45 percent on the two Cascade Smile & Sight Savings memberships and 50 percent on the two Plus memberships.
- **Individual and Household of one family.** Within each pair (Smile Savings, Smile & Sight Savings, Smile & Sight Savings Plus) the Individual and Household memberships carry identical dental percentages.
- **Practice without a savings-network agreement.** No dental discount is honored there under any membership.
